rationale: All six propositions retain their original strength and distinct citation: “can increase” (Rahmani; Okeke & Vidal), “may shape” (Sato), “can improve…without improving” (Dlamini & Kroll), “has been associated with” (Petrescu), and “may signal” (Al-Masri & Ko). No citation was dropped, merged, misattributed, or attached to the current findings. The final mapping preserves the study’s observational language—“were associated with” and “predicted”—while the added interpretations (“pair exposure to difference with a normative signal” and “a breach of interaction norms”) implement R-2’s authorized conceptual link without strengthening the reported effects.
